title: Cis quinoxaline ligand: six-bond geometry validation
category: molecular geometry optimization and vibrational validation
difficulty_reasons: The molecular identity and endpoint are fixed, but the Agent must select a defensible computational protocol and construct an explicit atom mapping from a crystallographic record.
The Agent must validate a stationary point and perform a quantitative bond-length comparison while reporting gas-phase versus solid-state limitations.

paper.title: Structural and antimicrobial studies on a tricarbonyl rhenium(i) complex with the 6,7-dimethyl-2-(pyridin-2-yl)quinoxaline ligand

data.description: Supplied immutable CCDC 2433822 CIF and compound-1 metadata, including identity, charge and multiplicity; CCDC retrieval is not scored.

required_deliverables.description: Structured calculation, validation, mapped bond comparison and conclusion.
